sft.description: Base policy fine-tuned on real signal training_v2 dataset without verifier discrimination or RL.

verifier_filter.description: SFT fine-tuned policy gated by calibrated 12-dimensional actionability verifier model.

grpo.description: SFT policy optimized directly via Group-Relative Policy Optimization using Reward v2.0.0.

full_stack.description: Real Data Mixing + SFT + Calibrated Verifier Filter + GRPO v2.0.0 + Container Sandbox.

conclusion: Full stack (Real Signal Mixing + SFT + Verifier + GRPO v2 + Sandbox) achieves highest performance (F1=0.737, Clean FPR=0.063), +31.9% relative F1 improvement over SFT baseline.
